raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 5012 rows but only 4866 distinct txn_ids. Every delivery batch carries more rows than its txn_id range, so about 146 records were delivered twice. The silver step casts and filters on status but never deduplicates, so 137 POSTED txn_ids are counted twice. The other 9 are REVERSED-only and get filtered out. All gold aggregates are inflated by the same duplicates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC, txn_ts DESC, amount DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) d WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
